verdict.rationale: A government IP office could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas or a data dictionary for a machine channel, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only human-facing gov.uk guidance, online and paper filing, and web search tools. It never mentions an API specification, schema or data dictionary, and the probe touched only robots.txt.
